search_scale_requirements: Target index: 350M documents; query volume: 50M queries/month peak 120QPS; cold-start ingestion cadence: daily delta up to 5M docs.
quality_targets: Per-language recall@10 >= 0.85 for EN/DE/FR, >=0.75 for ES, target >=0.70 for JA/KO after rerank; precision@3 >=0.6 across markets.
cost_constraints: Desired blended cost per query <$0.003 at 10QPS; acceptable up to $0.007 at heavy spikes; want explicit budget cap for pilot.
preferred_models: multilingual embedding encoders + lightweight cross-encoder rerankers; open to Redwood's verified models and quantized variants; avoid large decoder models for rerank.
routing_requirements: Route by language + region; prefer EU-hosted for EU data, fallback to low-cost region for non-sensitive content; need automatic fallback to smaller rerank model when capacity constrained.
poCs_and_milestones: Phase 1: 2M doc sample + eval vectors (complete). Phase 2: 20M sample + rerank tuning (in progress). Phase 3: full index pilot + SLA test (requested May).
